description: SHARED BUDGETS on Google Ads: one daily amount several campaigns draw from. action list (default): every shared budget with its daily amount and the campaigns on it. create: name + dailyBudget (the account currency); it spends nothing until a campaign draws from it. attach: budgetId + campaignIds moves those campaigns onto it; a LIVE campaign moved onto a budget with a HIGHER daily amount than it has now can spend more, so show the user and pass confirm:true (a lower one never asks). A campaign's own budget is changed with set_google_ads_budget. dryRun:true has Google check a write. Read back from Google. Free.

campaignIds.description: attach: campaigns to move onto the budget

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change that can raise spend on a LIVE campaign

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits; omit for the brand's selected default account

dailyBudget.description: create: the daily amount in the account currency

dryRun.description: true = Google validates it and nothing changes

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through one; omit otherwise

name.description: create: the budget name, unique on the account

name: manage_google_ads_shared_budgets
title: Google Ads shared budgets
